correctness.rationale: For same-side vertices with indices \(i\ne j\), direct distance calculation gives distinctive set exactly \(P_i\cup P_j\); every opposite-side pair is distinguished by all vertices. Thus \(S\) is a \(k\)-metric generator iff \(c_i+c_j\ge k\) for all distinct indices, where \(c_i\in\{0,1,2\}\). Exact integer minimization yields \(n-1,n,2n-1,2n\), with the claimed unique profile types. The bundled verifier reconstructs distances and exhaustively confirms every subset for \(3\le n\le9\). The finite check is corroborative, not the proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification for a standard distance-transitive graph family under a robustness hierarchy designed precisely to measure redundant localization. The result gives the maximal feasible robustness, every exact dimension, every minimum basis, and exact counts, and it identifies fault tolerance with perfect-matching transversals. The profile reduction \(c_i+c_j\ge k\) exposes a structural mechanism rather than a routine isolated computation.
